subject: Post-call recap & request: VP/CTO intro availability to unblock pilot
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finbridge.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap & request: VP/CTO intro availability to unblock pilot

Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our discovery: 

- Key goals: reduce latency on customer-facing inference, predictable unit economics for peak traffic, and integration with FinBridge's VPC/ingestion pipeline for compliance.
- Constraints you mentioned: data residency for EU customers (timeline Q1 2027), legal wants audit-log granularity, and pilot needs ability to run behind your firewall for a short smoke test.
- Success criteria for pilot: 10k RPS equivalent for inference with p95 < 200ms, and end-to-end cost estimate below your current baseline for 1M monthly tokens.

To move procurement and engineering alignment along, we should lock an executive handshake (VP/CTO intro) so your leadership can validate performance/roadmap and we can get procurement checkboxes started. Suggested ask: 30–45m VP/CTO intro + technical deep-dive with infra lead.

Proposed windows (Pacific time):
- Tue 12/07 — 09:00–10:00 or 15:00–15:45 PT
- Wed 12/08 — 11:00–11:45 or 16:00–16:45 PT

Suggested attendees (we’ll bring): Markus (me), Lauren (Solutions Eng lead), Neha (Account lead). Please let us know which of the above works, or propose two other slots. I attached a one-page mutual action plan and the requirement summary we promised.

Attachments: FinBridge_MAP_v1.xlsx, FinBridge_requirements.pdf

Thanks — aim to get this locked this week to keep momentum.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

- Can you send a 2–3 bullet agenda for the exec portion? Our CTO prefers a short run-through of risk/SLAs and the pilot exit criteria.

If Tue 12/07 15:00–15:45 PT is ok for you/CTO, we’ll send a calendar invite for a 45m slot (exec + short handoff to tech). If the CTO prefers Wed 12/08 11:00–11:45 PT, same flow.
